newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LTV cut to accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LTV cut to accumulate.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday it lowered its rating on the shares of LTV Corp to accumulate from buy, based on lower earnings expectations going forward and changes in the way LTV uses its cash.
-- Analyst Aldo Mazzaferro said in a research note he lowered his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.94 per share from $1.10 and his 1998 estimate to $1.20 per share from $1.25.

-- Mazzaferro said the company's TRICO startup was going slower than forecast, and the closure of a coke battery would cause a $150 million charge in the third quarter. This would drain $100 million in cash, he said.
-- LTV's share repurchase plan is also proceeding slower than anticipated, Mazzaferro said.
